title: FOMC minutes — the September 14-15, 2027 meeting (2:00 p.m. ET, three weeks after the decision)
source: EST: the Board's own stated publication rule applied to a meeting date this session read directly, then checked against every instance this calendar already carries. THE RULE is verbatim from federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, footer "Last Update: August 19, 2026"): "The minutes of regularly scheduled meetings are released three weeks after the date of the policy decision." THE MEETING is the same page's 2027 panel, "September 14-15*" -- Tuesday and Wednesday, with a Summary of Economic Projections. Decision day 2027-09-15 plus 21 days is Wednesday 2027-10-06. THE ARITHMETIC IS VALIDATED AGAINST FIVE ENTRIES THIS CALENDAR ALREADY HOLDS, 5 of 5 exact: fomc-minutes-2026-10-07 (Sep 15-16 decision + 21), fomc-minutes-2026-11-18 (Oct 27-28 + 21), fomc-minutes-2026-12-30 (Dec 8-9 + 21), fomc-minutes-2027-06-30 (Jun 8-9 + 21) and fomc-minutes-2027-08-18 (Jul 27-28 + 21). A PARSING TRAP WAS CLEARED FIRST, and it is recorded because it corrupts nearest-FOMC arithmetic silently: the 2027 panel's own footnote reads "Note: A two-day meeting is scheduled for January 25-26, 2028.", so a year-scoped parse of that panel returns NINE 2027 meetings including a phantom 2027-01-25/26; cutting each panel at its footnote block returns 56 meetings, exactly 8 in each year 2021-2027. The 2:00 p.m. ET release time is the Board's standing convention and is not stated on this page. Filed estimate because the rule is firm but the meeting date is TENTATIVE by the page's own words -- "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it" -- so the promotion trigger is the 2027-07-27/28 meeting ratifying September 14-15, not a better fetch. Discovered during the fhfa-hpi-2027-09-28 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the fhfa-hpi-2027-09-28 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). Proposed because the whole corridor around 2027-09-28 held exactly TWO tracked ids before this PR -- consumer-confidence-2027-09-28 at 10:00 the same morning, and the fomc-2027-09-15 proposal thirteen days earlier -- and the minutes of that same meeting were missing even though this calendar already tracks the five preceding minutes releases and derives each by the identical rule. It lands 8 days AFTER the FHFA print and 20 days BEFORE the October 26-27 FOMC, inside the October blackout window (2027-10-16 -> 2027-10-28) only if the minutes were to slip ten days, which they never have in this calendar's record. THREE NOTES FOR WHOEVER TAKES IT. (1) This is a POST-SEP meeting's minutes: the September 14-15 meeting carries a Summary of Economic Projections (the page's own asterisk), so the minutes read against a published dot plot rather than in a vacuum -- a different animal from the July 2027 minutes the fomc-2027-07-28 lane proposed. (2) The September 2027 meeting is the ONLY non-third-Tuesday September in seven postings, which is what moved the blackout to Sep 4-16 and gave the 2027-09-28 FHFA print its 13-day post-decision gap; if the 2027-07-27/28 meeting restores September to the third Tuesday (Sep 21-22), THIS DATE MOVES TOO, to 2027-10-13. That is the single kill switch worth carrying forward. (3) The proposing lane's own measurement says nothing tradeable sits on the FHFA side of this corridor -- symbols: [], 0 playbook hits -- so this proposal is calendar completeness, not a signal. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
